messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

Mostly good, comments inline. The mode check does look like the right fix: LCK_PW + exactly MDS_INODELOCK_OPEN is today reachable only from the lease branch of mdt_object_open_lock().

The change has no test coverage, and the existing LU-11926 regression test can no longer catch this class of bug. sanity test_319 was reworked in abe5c93175 to run `lfs migrate -m1` on the parent directory, but ll_migrate() only takes a lease for S_ISREG children, so no lease lock is created at all; on top of that the racing `dd if=$file` is a read open (LCK_CR), which is compatible with the LCK_PW lease and never produces a blocking AST. Could this patch add a case that takes a lease on a regular file and then races an open for write, so the flag is actually exercised?

commit.subject: LU-20488 mdt: broken lease lock check in mdt_object_lock_internal
commit.message:
LU-20488 mdt: broken lease lock check in mdt_object_lock_internal

mdt_object_lock_internal() incorrectly checks for lease locks so
LDLM_FL_CANCEL_ON_BLOCK is never set for lease locks.

Signed-off-by: Andrew Perepechko <andrew.perepechko@hpe.com>
Change-Id: I630aead26bae32be847c4a7222ed76cdff26ff39
Fixes: 2869f429ddc9 ("LU-13668 mdt: change lock mode for lease")
HPE-bug-id: LUS-13312
